prompt: Create a separate worktree and turn the chosen Wave 1 SKU into a value-first activation experiment. Define the event contract from workflow_map_started to first_win_verified, five route fixtures, five second-user activation scripts, success/failure thresholds, PII minimization, support escalation, and stay-free/not-ready/refer-out outcomes. Draft only; do not edit FrankX, Academy, community, checkout, production, tracking configuration, customer data, public pages, or send messages. Done when the experiment is executable from local fixtures, every event maps to a user-value decision, no dark pattern is present, and the resultRef records evidence, assumptions, and stop/kill criteria.
